identity: Mono-black aggro built around Mornsong Aria as a conditional closer rather than a lock. The bulk of the damage comes from above-rate and evasive black bodies - Chaos Spewer (5/4 for three), Retched Wretch (4/2 for three), and Dream Seizer, Voracious Tome-Skimmer and Dawnhand Eulogist in the air and through menace. Aria is cast only once the board is ahead, at which point its symmetric 'that player loses 3 life' clock kills the opponent several turns before it kills me, its per-turn tutor upgrades every remaining draw step into a chosen card, and its 'Players can't draw cards or gain life' clause blanks both the opponent's card draw and any attempt to stabilise on life. No card in the deck DEPENDS on drawing or gaining life, and zero cards contain the words 'draw a card' - but the claim is stated precisely: four copies carry a blanked gain-life rider (Requiting Hex x2 'you gain 2 life', Dawnhand Eulogist x2 'and you gain 2 life') plus Rooftop Percher in the sideboard, and all of them still perform their main function. Consequently Requiting Hex's optional blight is never paid, because the only thing that cost buys is the life.

card_pool_rules.extra_constraint: max 5 rare+mythic total across mainboard and sideboard

checklist.base: cube_mainboard - every card verified present in the working pool by exact name.
checklist.copy_limits: Commons and uncommons capped at 2, rares and mythics at 1; the Phase 5C validator cross-checked every combined mainboard+sideboard count against cube_search.get_max_copies and returned PASS.
checklist.rare_mythic_budget: 3 of the maximum 5: Mornsong Aria (rare, MB), Shadow Urchin (rare, MB), Dawnhand Dissident (rare, SB). Two slots deliberately left unused after Bitterbloom Bearer (mythic) was cut in the Phase 9 repair.
checklist.basics: 17 Swamp - format-supplied and exempt from copy limits.
checklist.colour: All 20 distinct nonland cards return a usable 'cast' mode from effective_cost.best_mode against core_colors ['B']; the five hybrid cards (Chaos Spewer {2}{B/R}, Shadow Urchin {2}{B/R}, Eclipsed Elf {B/G}{B/G}{B/G}, Voracious Tome-Skimmer {U/B}{U/B}{U/B}, Mischievous Sneakling {1}{U/B}) are cast entirely off Swamps, so splash_colors is empty.

mainboard.name: Requiting Hex
mainboard.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may blight 1. (You may put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control.)
Destroy target creature with mana value 2 or less. If this spell's additional cost was paid, you gain 2 life.

mainboard.name: Bile-Vial Boggart
mainboard.oracle_text: When this creature dies, put a -1/-1 counter on up to one target creature.

mainboard.name: Voracious Tome-Skimmer
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever you cast a spell during an opponent's turn, you may pay 1 life. If you do, draw a card.

mainboard.name: Creakwood Safewright
mainboard.oracle_text:
This creature enters with three -1/-1 counters on it.
At the beginning of your end step, if there is an Elf card in your graveyard and this creature has a -1/-1 counter on it, remove a -1/-1 counter from this creature.

mainboard.name: Nameless Inversion
mainboard.oracle_text:
Changeling (This card is every creature type.)
Target creature gets +3/-3 and loses all creature types until end of turn.

mainboard.name: Bogslither's Embrace
mainboard.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, blight 1 or pay {3}. (To blight 1, put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control.)
Exile target creature.

mainboard.name: Chaos Spewer
mainboard.oracle_text: When this creature enters, you may pay {2}. If you don't, blight 2. (To blight 2, put two -1/-1 counters on a creature you control.)

mainboard.name: Retched Wretch
mainboard.oracle_text: When this creature dies, if it had a -1/-1 counter on it, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control and it loses all abilities.

mainboard.name: Eclipsed Elf
mainboard.oracle_text: When this creature enters, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal an Elf, Swamp, or Forest card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

mainboard.name: Shadow Urchin
mainboard.oracle_text:
Whenever this creature attacks, blight 1. (Put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control.)
Whenever a creature you control with one or more counters on it dies, exile that many cards from the top of your library. Until your next end step, you may play those cards.

mainboard.name: Mornsong Aria
mainboard.oracle_text:
Players can't draw cards or gain life.
At the beginning of each player's draw step, that player loses 3 life, searches their library for a card, puts it into their hand, then shuffles.

mainboard.name: Dream Seizer
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flying
When this creature enters, you may blight 1. If you do, each opponent discards a card. (To blight 1, put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control.)

mainboard.name: Dawnhand Eulogist
mainboard.oracle_text:
Menace (This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
When this creature enters, mill three cards. Then if there is an Elf card in your graveyard, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life. (To mill three cards, put the top three cards of your library into your graveyard.)

sideboard.name: Dawnhand Dissident
sideboard.oracle_text:
{T}, Blight 1: Surveil 1.
{T}, Blight 2: Exile target card from a graveyard.
During your turn, you may cast creature spells from among cards you own exiled with this creature by removing three counters from among creatures you control in addition to paying their other costs.
sideboard.when_to_board: Vs the cube's 39 graveyard-interaction cards; '{T}, Blight 2: Exile target card from a graveyard' is repeatable on a 1-mana body.

sideboard.name: Rooftop Percher
sideboard.oracle_text:
Changeling (This card is every creature type.)
Flying
When this creature enters, exile up to two target cards from graveyards. You gain 3 life.
sideboard.when_to_board: Vs reanimator/flashback decks; 'exile up to two target cards from graveyards' plus a 3/3 flier that fits the evasion plan. Kept over the Challenger's proposed cut because Dawnhand Dissident and this are the ONLY two graveyard answers castable off Swamps in the entire 282-card pool, against a 39-card threat class.

sideboard.name: Darkness Descends
sideboard.oracle_text: Put two -1/-1 counters on each creature.
sideboard.when_to_board: Vs token and go-wide decks (~40 token-generation cards in the cube); 'Put two -1/-1 counters on each creature' is the only mass creature effect in the pool castable off Swamps. Asymmetric here because Retched Wretch returns through it: 'if it had a -1/-1 counter on it, return it to the battlefield'.

sideboard.name: Blight Rot
sideboard.oracle_text: Put four -1/-1 counters on target creature.
sideboard.when_to_board: Vs the cube's 41 evasion cards; 'Put four -1/-1 counters on target creature' at instant speed kills any flier with toughness 4 or less.

sideboard.name: Auntie's Sentence
sideboard.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland permanent card from it. That player discards that card.
• Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: Vs slower decks, strip their best nonland permanent; vs x/2 evasive creatures, use the -2/-2 mode.

sideboard.name: Perfect Intimidation
sideboard.oracle_text:
Choose one or both —
• Target opponent exiles two cards from their hand.
• Remove all counters from target creature.
sideboard.when_to_board: Vs control and combo; 'Target opponent exiles two cards from their hand' is permanent card advantage once Mornsong Aria has shut off their draw. Second mode 'Remove all counters from target creature' also un-shrinks my own Creakwood Safewright to a 5/5.

sideboard.name: Mischievous Sneakling
sideboard.oracle_text:
Changeling (This card is every creature type.)
Flash
sideboard.when_to_board: Vs faster aggro; Flash lets a 2/2 ambush an attacker without costing a deployment turn.

identity_es: Agro mono negro construido alrededor de Mornsong Aria como cierre condicional y no como bloqueo. El grueso del daño viene de cuerpos negros por encima de tasa y evasivos: Chaos Spewer (5/4 por tres), Retched Wretch (4/2 por tres), y Dream Seizer, Voracious Tome-Skimmer y Dawnhand Eulogist por el aire y con amenaza. Aria se lanza solo cuando el tablero va por delante, momento en el cual su reloj simétrico de 'that player loses 3 life' mata al rival varios turnos antes que a mí, su tutor por turno mejora cada paso de robar restante a una carta elegida, y su cláusula de 'Players can't draw cards or gain life' anula tanto el robo del rival como cualquier intento de estabilizar con vida. Ninguna carta del mazo DEPENDE de robar o ganar vida, y cero cartas contienen las palabras 'draw a card'; pero la afirmación se hace con precisión: cuatro copias llevan un añadido anulado de ganar vida (Requiting Hex x2 'you gain 2 life', Dawnhand Eulogist x2 'and you gain 2 life') más Rooftop Percher en el banquillo, y todas siguen cumpliendo su función principal. En consecuencia, el blight opcional de Requiting Hex no se paga nunca, porque lo único que compra ese coste es la vida.
